title: VtDA20 Combat Automation
description: Combat automation for the World of Darkness 20th Edition system with actor-type profiles: Kindred, ghoul, mortal, hunter, Garou/Changing Breed, mage, changeling, wraith/ghost, spirit, creature, demon, mummy and Exalted. Attack, defense, damage, soak (silver, cold iron, Fortitude, armor), health track, Rage extra actions, VtDA20 maneuvers and optional World of Darkness: Combat maneuvers.
